en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from one of his companions, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who goes out from his house wearing a turban (passing) beneath his chin, intending a journey, would neither be hit during his journey by theft, nor by burning, nor by abhorrence’.
